headline: A House resolution that would have removed Representative Eric Swalwell from the House Intelligence Committee; the House voted to table it, so it did not pass.
what_it_does: If adopted, this resolution would have removed Representative Eric Swalwell from the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence. The House voted on March 18, 2021, to table the measure or send it back to committee, so it was not adopted. The summary does not describe any other changes.

who_it_affects.how: He would have lost his seat on the House Intelligence Committee, which handles oversight of U.S. intelligence agencies.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House Intelligence Committee
who_it_affects.how: Their committee membership would have changed by one seat, which could have affected committee work and votes.
